text:
[SUMMARY]
Logging of GCS related events
[DESCRIPTION]
The _ActivityLogger_ shall log all commands sent to and messages received from a _CGS_.
conv: summari log gcs relat event descript activ logger shall log command sent messag receiv cgs

text:
[SUMMARY]
Support for GCS connected UAVs
[DESCRIPTION]
The _VehicleCore_ shall support UAVs connected via the _GCS_
conv: summari support gcs connect uav descript vehicl core shall support uav connect via gcs

text:
[SUMMARY]
Manual Flight Plan Assignment
[DESCRIPTION]
If a route contains a specific {{UAV_ID}}  the _SingleUAVFlightPlanScheduler_ shall assign the route to the given UAV.
conv: summari manual flight plan assign descript rout contain specif uav singl uavflight plan schedul shall assign rout given uav

text:
[SUMMARY]
Visiting waypoints during flight plan 
[DESCRIPTION]
When a flight plan is executed  the _VehicleCore_ shall send the next waypoint to the UAV.
conv: summari visit waypoint flight plan descript flight plan execut vehicl core shall send next waypoint uav

text:
[SUMMARY]
Establish maximum number of activated UAVs
[DESCRIPTION]
When the maximum numbers of allowed activated UAVs has been reached  the _UAVActivationManager_ shall reject any further activation requests.
conv: summari establish maximum number activ uav descript maximum number allow activ uav reach uavactiv manag shall reject activ request

text:
[SUMMARY]
Support for internally simulated UAVs
[DESCRIPTION]
The _VehicleCore_ shall support virtual UAVs
conv: summari support intern simul uav descript vehicl core shall support virtual uav

text:
[SUMMARY]
UI middleware lists all saved flight routes
[DESCRIPTION]
The _UIMiddleware_ shall provide a list of all existing routes
conv: summari middlewar list save flight rout descript uimiddlewar shall provid list exist rout

text:
[SUMMARY]
Mission Planning
[DESCRIPTION]
The _MissionPlanner_ shall execute flight plans for multiple UAVs concurrently.
conv: summari mission plan descript mission planner shall execut flight plan multipl uav concurr

text:
[SUMMARY]
Logging of Flight Plan related Events
[DESCRIPTION]
The _ActivityLogger_ shall log all flight plan related events.
conv: summari log flight plan relat event descript activ logger shall log flight plan relat event

text:
[SUMMARY]
UI accepts mission plans
[DESCRIPTION]
The _UIMiddleware_ shall accept and activate a mission plan upon request.
conv: summari accept mission plan descript uimiddlewar shall accept activ mission plan upon request

text:
[SUMMARY]
Multiple Map Types
[DESCRIPTION]
The _MapComponent_ shall support different types of map layers (e.g.  terrain  satellite)
conv: summari multipl map type descript map compon shall support differ type map layer terrain satellit

text:
[SUMMARY]
Transmit Route assignments to UI Middleware
[DESCRIPTION]
When a route is assigned or removed from a UAV  the _RouteAssignmentUI_ shall notify Dronology.
conv: summari transmit rout assign middlewar descript rout assign remov uav rout assign shall notifi dronolog

text:
[SUMMARY]
Monitoring Messages
[DESCRIPTION]
The _DronologyRuntimeMonitor_ shall provide functionality to retrieve monitoring messages and distribute them to clients
conv: summari monitor messag descript dronolog runtim monitor shall provid function retriev monitor messag distribut client

text:
[SUMMARY]
UAV Commands
[DESCRIPTION]
The _GCSMiddleware_ shall forward commands sent from Dronology to a _GCS_
conv: summari uav command descript gcsmiddlewar shall forward command sent dronolog gcs

text:
[SUMMARY]
Groundstation-Middleware Communication Protocol
[DESCRIPTION]
The _GCSMiddleware _ shall follow a predefined set of steps to establish a connection between a _GCS_ and Dronology
conv: summari groundstat middlewar communic protocol descript gcsmiddlewar shall follow predefin set step establish connect gcs dronolog

text:
[SUMMARY]
Calculate distances
[DESCRIPTION]
When given two coordinates the _CoordinateSystem_ shall compute the distance between them.
conv: summari calcul distanc descript given two coordin coordin system shall comput distanc

text:
[SUMMARY]
Only one instance of each registered drone may be active any any time
[DESCRIPTION]
The _UAVActivationManager_ shall ensure that only one instance of each registered drone is active at any time.
conv: summari one instanc regist drone may activ time descript uavactiv manag shall ensur one instanc regist drone activ time

text:
[SUMMARY]
Display active routes
[DESCRIPTION]
The _RealTimeFlightUI_ shall display all currently active flight plans on the map.
conv: summari display activ rout descript real time flight shall display current activ flight plan map

text:
[SUMMARY]
Flight route defined as waypoints
[DESCRIPTION]
The _FlightRouteManager_ shall define flight routes as an ordered sequence of waypoints in which the first waypoint represents the first target location and the final waypoint represents the final target location.
conv: summari flight rout defin waypoint descript flight rout manag shall defin flight rout order sequenc waypoint first waypoint repres first target locat final waypoint repres final target locat

text:
[SUMMARY]
Delete a route
[DESCRIPTION]
The _RouteCreationUI_ shall allow a user to delete a route.
conv: summari delet rout descript rout creation shall allow user delet rout

text:
[SUMMARY]
Assigning new flight plan upon completion of previous flight
[DESCRIPTION]
If a UAV has pending flight plans  then when it reaches the final waypoint of its current flight plan  the _SingleUAVFlightPlanScheduler_ shall execute the next assigned flight plan.
conv: summari assign new flight plan upon complet previous flight descript uav pend flight plan reach final waypoint current flight plan singl uavflight plan schedul shall execut next assign flight plan

text:
[SUMMARY]
Flight route persistence
[DESCRIPTION]
The _FlightRouteManager_ shall persist flight routes.
conv: summari flight rout persist descript flight rout manag shall persist flight rout

text:
[SUMMARY]
UAV Identification
[DESCRIPTION]
The _VehicleCore_ shall assign a unique ID to each activated UAV.
conv: summari uav identif descript vehicl core shall assign uniqu activ uav

text:
[SUMMARY]
Publishing Monitoring Messages
[DESCRIPTION]
The _DronologyRuntimeMonitor_ shall be able to receive messages from any Dronology component
conv: summari publish monitor messag descript dronolog runtim monitor shall abl receiv messag dronolog compon

text:
[SUMMARY]
Coordinate system conversion
[DESCRIPTION]
When requested  the _CoordinateSystem_ shall transform coordinates to alternate formats.
conv: summari coordin system convers descript request coordin system shall transform coordin altern format

text:
[SUMMARY]
Removal of planned flight
[DESCRIPTION]
If requested  the _SingleUAVFlightPlanScheduler_ shall unassign the flight plan assigned to a UAV that is awaiting execution.
conv: summari remov plan flight descript request singl uavflight plan schedul shall unassign flight plan assign uav await execut

text:
[SUMMARY]
Display map in UI
[DESCRIPTION]
When the _RealTimeFlightUI_ is loaded  a map shall be displayed.
conv: summari display map descript real time flight load map shall display

text:
[SUMMARY]
Route creation and modification
[DESCRIPTION]
The _RouteCreationUI_ shall allow the user to create and modify a route.
conv: summari rout creation modif descript rout creation shall allow user creat modifi rout

text:
[SUMMARY]
Remove pending plans when return-to-home
[DESCRIPTION]
When a UAV's current flight is cancelled  the _SingleUAVFlightPlanScheduler_ shall in turn cancel all scheduled flight plans for that UAV.
conv: summari remov pend plan return home descript uav current flight cancel singl uavflight plan schedul shall turn cancel schedul flight plan uav

text:
[SUMMARY]
Connect GCS to Dronology via Middleware
[DESCRIPTION]
The _GCSMiddleware_ shall handle multiple _GCS_
conv: summari connect gcs dronolog via middlewar descript gcsmiddlewar shall handl multipl gcs

text:
[SUMMARY]
Load default coordinates
[DESCRIPTION]
When loading the map view it shall be positioned at the pre-defined location
conv: summari load default coordin descript load map view shall posit pre defin locat

text:
[SUMMARY]
UAV Messages
[DESCRIPTION]
The _GCSMiddleware_ shall handle state messages   monitoring messages  and mode change messages  received from an _GCS_.
conv: summari uav messag descript gcsmiddlewar shall handl state messag monitor messag mode chang messag receiv gcs

text:
[SUMMARY]
Specify takeoff altitude
[DESCRIPTION]
When a flight route requires a customized takeoff altitude that differs from the system's default takeoff altitude  it shall be specified in the flight route.
conv: summari specifi takeoff altitud descript flight rout requir custom takeoff altitud differ system default takeoff altitud shall specifi flight rout

text:
[SUMMARY]
UAV Flight Plan Execution
[DESCRIPTION]
The _SingleUAVFlightPlanScheduler_ shall only execute one flight plan at a time for each UAV.
conv: summari uav flight plan execut descript singl uavflight plan schedul shall execut one flight plan time uav

text:
[SUMMARY]
Display activated UAVs
[DESCRIPTION]
The _RealTimeFlightUI_ shall display the name and status of all currently activated UAVs
conv: summari display activ uav descript real time flight shall display name status current activ uav

text:
[SUMMARY]
Following UAVs
[DESCRIPTION]
The _RealTimeFlightUI_ shall allow users to follow one or multiple UAVs on the map.
conv: summari follow uav descript real time flight shall allow user follow one multipl uav map

text:
[SUMMARY]
Modify assigned routes
[DESCRIPTION]
A user may reorder routes or remove flight plans assigned to a UAV as long as the flight has not started execution.
conv: summari modifi assign rout descript user may reorder rout remov flight plan assign uav long flight start execut

text:
[SUMMARY]
Assign Routes
[DESCRIPTION]
The _RouteAssignmentUI_ shall provide means to select an existing routes and assign them to a UAV.
conv: summari assign rout descript rout assign shall provid mean select exist rout assign uav

text:
[SUMMARY]
UAV Operations
[DESCRIPTION]
The _RealTimeFlightUI_ shall allow users to apply flight operations to one or more selected UAVs.
conv: summari uav oper descript real time flight shall allow user appli flight oper one select uav

text:
[SUMMARY]
Display a list of existing routes
[DESCRIPTION]
When the _RouteCreationUI_ is loaded a list of all existing routes shall be displayed.
conv: summari display list exist rout descript rout creation load list exist rout shall display

text:
[SUMMARY]
Emergency operations
[DESCRIPTION]
The _RealTimeFlightUI_ shall allow users to perform emergency operations (e.g. hovering multiple UAVs  sending multiple UAVs to home) to a group of UAVs
conv: summari emerg oper descript real time flight shall allow user perform emerg oper hover multipl uav send multipl uav home group uav

text:
[SUMMARY]
UI middleware supports route assignment to UAV
[DESCRIPTION]
The _UIMiddleware_ shall enable an existing route to be assigned to an active UAV.
conv: summari middlewar support rout assign uav descript uimiddlewar shall enabl exist rout assign activ uav

text:
[SUMMARY]
Hover at completion of flight
[DESCRIPTION]
If a UAV does not have any pending flight plans  then when it reaches the final waypoint of its current flight plan  the _SingleUAVFlightPlanScheduler_ shall notify the UAV to hover in place.
conv: summari hover complet flight descript uav pend flight plan reach final waypoint current flight plan singl uavflight plan schedul shall notifi uav hover place

text:
[SUMMARY]
Predefined flight patterns
[DESCRIPTION]
The _MissionPlanner _shall manage predefined FlightPatterns
conv: summari predefin flight pattern descript mission planner shall manag predefin flight pattern

text:
[SUMMARY]
Simulate land
[DESCRIPTION]
When given a landing command the _InternalSimulator_ shall move the UAV from to the ground altitude corresponding to its current longitude and latitude.
conv: summari simul land descript given land command intern simul shall move uav ground altitud correspond current longitud latitud

text:
[SUMMARY]
UAV State transitions
[DESCRIPTION]
When requested  the _VehicleCore_ shall shall transition the UAV between states according to allowed state transitions as depicted in the UAV state transition diagram
conv: summari uav state transit descript request vehicl core shall shall transit uav state accord allow state transit depict uav state transit diagram

text:
[SUMMARY]
Simulate battery
[DESCRIPTION]
The _InternalSimulator_ shall approximate the state of the battery
conv: summari simul batteri descript intern simul shall approxim state batteri

text:
[SUMMARY]
UI middleware provides support for modifying flight routes
[DESCRIPTION]
The _UIMiddleware_ shall enable the creation and modification of flight routes
conv: summari middlewar provid support modifi flight rout descript uimiddlewar shall enabl creation modif flight rout

text:
[SUMMARY]
Simulate goto
[DESCRIPTION]
When given a goto command  the _InternalSimulator_ shall update the location of the UAV at increments of {{SIMULATION_STEP_SIZE}} meters  moving it towards the target destination until the destination is reached.
conv: summari simul goto descript given goto command intern simul shall updat locat uav increment simul step size meter move toward target destin destin reach

text:
[SUMMARY]
Simulate takeoff
[DESCRIPTION]
When given a takeoff command the _InternalSimulator_ shall move the UAV to the takeoff altitude corresponding to its current longitude and latitude.
conv: summari simul takeoff descript given takeoff command intern simul shall move uav takeoff altitud correspond current longitud latitud

text:
[SUMMARY]
Waypoint definition
[DESCRIPTION]
Each waypoint shall be specified using coordinates that include longitude  latitude  and altitude.
conv: summari waypoint definit descript waypoint shall specifi use coordin includ longitud latitud altitud

text:
[SUMMARY]
Flight Plan scheduling
[DESCRIPTION]
When requested  the _SingleUAVFlightPlanScheduler_ shall schedule a route for execution.
conv: summari flight plan schedul descript request singl uavflight plan schedul shall schedul rout execut

text:
[SUMMARY]
UI middleware forwards commands from clients to dronology
[DESCRIPTION]
The _UIMiddleware_ accepts commands from UIs and forwards to Dronology
conv: summari middlewar forward command client dronolog descript uimiddlewar accept command forward dronolog

text:
[SUMMARY]
UI middleware lists currently active UAVs
[DESCRIPTION]
The _UIMiddleware_ shall provide a list of all active UAVs
conv: summari middlewar list current activ uav descript uimiddlewar shall provid list activ uav

text:
[SUMMARY]
Return To Home without detours
[DESCRIPTION]
"When the ""return to home"" command is issued  the _FlightManager_ shall return the UAV to its original launch location without issuing any additional waypoint or routing commands."
conv: summari return home without detour descript return home command issu flight manag shall return uav origin launch locat without issu addit waypoint rout command

text:
[SUMMARY]
Deactivates Physical UAVs
[DESCRIPTION]
When a UAV is deactivated the _UAVActivationManager_ shall cancel all current and scheduled flight plans
conv: summari deactiv physic uav descript uav deactiv uavactiv manag shall cancel current schedul flight plan

text:
[SUMMARY]
Cancel Mission
[DESCRIPTION]
When requested  if a mission is currently active  the _MissionPlanner _shall cancel the active mission.
conv: summari cancel mission descript request mission current activ mission planner shall cancel activ mission

text:
[SUMMARY]
Automatic Flight Plan Assignment
[DESCRIPTION]
If a scheduled flight is not manually assigned to a UAV  the _SingleUAVFlightPlanScheduler_ shall assign the route automatically to an UAV
conv: summari automat flight plan assign descript schedul flight manual assign uav singl uavflight plan schedul shall assign rout automat uav
